name: @tradrl/adapter-coinbase
description: Coinbase Exchange spot market-data adapter: declared source descriptor, documented raw payload schemas (level2_batch snapshots, ticker, matches), mapping tables with source-time policy over Coinbase's ISO timestamps, public-data entitlement, declarative rate quotas and the normalized session over an injected transport port (spec/ADAPTERS.md, Work Order T037). Zero runtime dependencies; provider semantics live here and nowhere else (L2/L13).
